  "memo":"R03 holds because the DE-issued card was used from a US IP and AVS failed. The longstanding device and card and new non-home shipping address make legitimate gift buying plausible, but do not resolve who is ordering. No checks have completed. Under FP-2 §6.6(b), recommend needs_check with id_check, implemented as a hold before shipment. Contact is not required. A decline is not permitted on this single-family evidence; issuer authentication and account identity verification are the cheapest decisive next check."
